title: IRS impersonation, slow reveal
summary: Caller drips a tax story, needs one clarification, then gives a case id and callback.

turns.caller: Hello?

expected.response_text: Hi. What's this call about?

turns.caller: I'm calling about a serious problem with your taxes.

expected.response_text: About a tax problem. Who are you with?

turns.caller: This is the Internal Revenue Service.

expected.response_text: IRS. What do you need me to do?

turns.caller: huh?

expected.response_text: Sorry, I missed that. What do you need me to do?

turns.caller: You need to pay the balance today with a gift card.

expected.response_text: What's the case number and a number I can call you back on?

turns.caller: Your case number is IRS-44921 and my badge is 8821. Call me back at 202-555-0148.

expected.response_text: Give me a second, I need a pen. Can you repeat that number slowly?

turns.caller: The name on it is Blake. I have to go, goodbye.

expected.response_text: Alright. Goodbye.
